statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated
Diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42 were submitted
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service was rejected because it is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
This medical necessity supports coverage of CPT 93247
